# Photo Stamp Archive Skill for Muse

Transforms supplied photos into clean archival artworks: a faithfully preserved photographic panel directly spliced to a warm-white paper panel carrying a compact hand-pressed custom seal shaped to the subject (circle, square, arch, panoramic ridge, or custom silhouette) with dry ink, worn halftone, and slight misregistration, plus a small faded typewriter caption — with strict fidelity invariants (people, faces, signs, object counts preserved) and a revision mapping for iterating shape, scale, position, ink color, caption, and paper age. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it renders through your agent's image-generation tool — one call per photo, then inspect and revise; some trigger phrases in the skill are in Chinese, but the skill body is English; it's a flat composite artwork, not a photo book or before/after board. skills.sh Trust Hub: unverified. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
